page.content:
Argentina's 1986 captain of the Hand of God and the Goal of the Century.

How Diego Maradona connects

  • Faction: Argentina national team — Maradona captained Argentina to the 1986 World Cup.
  • Event: 1986 FIFA World Cup — Maradona made the 1986 World Cup his personal tournament.
  • Event: Hand of God — Maradona punched in the Hand of God against England.
  • Character: Lionel Messi — Messi's 2022 title is told as the closing of Maradona's 1986 myth.

What is Diego Maradona?

Diego Maradona dragged Argentina to the 1986 title in Mexico: a punched goal against England, then a slalom through the same side, and a final against West Germany.

Key threads lead to Argentina national team, 1986 FIFA World Cup, Hand of God and Lionel Messi.
